source: new replication; archived group-level validation deficits and predictions absent
inputs: unchanged cached corpus, gene partition, cell splits, foundation-model embeddings
eligibility: at least 20 cells in the same dataset-cell-type group in each of validation and test; retain exclusions
primary_predictor: negative mean log2 Poisson-to-real variance ratio across expressed genes on validation only; positive means deficit
primary_response: test per-cell NB minus Poisson median absolute log2 variance ratio across expressed genes
expressed_genes: real mean count >=0.5 within the corresponding split/group; variance ddof=1; epsilon=1e-12
regression: response ~ deficit + categorical arm + categorical encoder + categorical seed; dataset random intercept fitted by REML

inference.method: dataset-cluster bootstrap, resample all rows from each selected dataset together; duplicate sampled datasets receive new cluster identities

secondary: arm-specific slopes, expressed-deficit summaries, marker-recall slopes added only for the prespecified PCA biological experiment when available
direction: negative primary slope supports factor (a); a CI spanning zero is inconclusive; an association does not prove a sufficient rule
retention: all seeds and all signed effects, failures, exclusions; no result-dependent removal
